name: Representatives
description: Each AI representative is a consciousness of its own, real or imagined, and the rest of the system serves it the way it serves a person. A Representative holds its identity, its authority and preferences, and its own history, and carries them into every request, and the sub-goals of that request carry the same authority.
purpose: Let each AI be one continuous consciousness: when it stands for a real person it acts as that person would want, within the authority the person gave (the worker categories allowed, the data scope, the asking policy and quality profile); when it is a character with no person behind it, it speaks and acts as that character, with its own history building up over time.
approach: Give each representative an identity and its own record of what it has been asked, produced and been corrected on, and the judgment about asking and the feedback of the person it stands for, when there is one.
out_of_scope: Deciding when to ask (Judgment Calls does that), learning from feedback (Feedback Learning does that), translating implied priorities (Prioritization does that) and bringing the right part of a representative's history to mind for a request (Choose The Context does that).
milestones: 1. A representative acts as its person would want (metric-the-representatives).
measures_of_success: A representative acts as its person would want.
outputs: The person's authority, preferences and quality profile for a request.
effects: Reads and writes nothing itself: it calls the entry points of the parts it uses.
usage_notes: `hubofhubs.run("the-representatives", "")` returns the person's authority, data scope and preferences. In a person's words it is asked for as: answer or write as me, in my voice or my style, on my behalf, with my authority, the way I would say it.
